programme.desc: Zwykła uliczna stłuczka staje się zalążkiem skomplikowanej zagadki kryminalnej: w jednym z uczestniczących w niej pojazdów zostaje znalezione ciało zamordowanego kominiarza, Romana Zielińskiego. Prowadzący auto mężczyzna ucieka.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Niespodziewanie w archiwum zjawia się młoda kobieta. Zuzi udaje się podsłuchać jej rozmowę z Henrykiem. Wynika z niej, że Kaję, byłą narzeczoną pasierba Mikosa, niedawno odwiedził mecenas Bohdan Kuchar.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Postrzelona przez Bazyla Zuza leży w szpitalu, na oddziale intensywnej terapii. Nie ma policyjnej ochrony. W jej sali zjawia się mężczyzna, skrywający twarz pod kapturem. Wyciąga broń z tłumikiem strzela do policjantki.

programme.title: Tylko jeden skecz
programme.desc: "Tylko jeden skecz" - program montażowy, w którym prezentujemy znane i lubiane skecze. W programie skecz: "Wizyta rodziców" w wykonaniu Kabaretu Moralnego Niepokoju.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Włodek, ojciec Michała, wychodzi po trzech latach z więzienia. Prokurator i komisarz Możejko proponują mu, aby został ich informatorem i pomógł w rozbiciu groźnego gangu. Po długich namowach Włodek zgadza się na współpracę.

programme.title: Tajemnica zamknięta w ołtarzu
programme.desc: Czym jest prestoł, na którym sprawowana jest Boska Liturgia? Jakie są jego elementy? Jak wygląda poświęcenie nowego ołtarza i jakie miejsce znajduje w prawosławnym rozumieniu liturgii?

programme.title: Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych
programme.desc: W niektórych przypadkach to już niestety zapewne ostatni moment, by rzemieślnicy podzielili się z nami swoimi coraz rzadszymi umiejętnościami. W tym odcinku cyklu odwiedzimy warsztat folusznika.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Sylwia przeżywa rozczarowanie postawą kapitana. Nie może się pogodzić z tym, że Karol ukrył przed nią fakt, iż wiedział o jej istnieniu. Karol wyjeżdża z Majaków i raczej nie wróci. Rozżalona Auguścikowa prosi go o wybaczenie.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Po wyjeździe ojca, Sylwia rzuca się w wir pracy. Razem z doktorem i Kozyrą dezynfekują chlew Bronka po aferze z afrykańskim pomorem świń. Dawid odrywa ją od obowiązków, zamyka lecznicę i zabiera nad rzekę. Romantyczna chwila nie trwa długo.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Dowiedziawszy się o śmierci znanego powieściopisarza Jana Oborniaka, redaktor naczelny wydawnictwa "Opoka" i pani redaktor Lusia zamierzają jak najszybciej wydać jego ostatnie dzieło "Krzyk ciszy". Okazuje się jednak, że rękopis zaginął.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester dostaje propozycję awansu, ale nie wie, czy nadaje się na lidera. Miras odkrywa, że internetowe algorytmy traktują go jak kobietę i postanawia "naprawić" swój wizerunek. Bruno uczy się z kolei gry w bejsbol, nieświadomie wkuwając zasady krykieta i palanta.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Aldona i Borys próbują ustalić kwotę zadośćuczynienia dla pana Bogumiła. Gdy mężczyzna staje się coraz bardziej natarczywy i inicjuje głośną awanturę w ich sklepie, małżeństwo Grzelaków ponownie szuka wsparcia u Natalii.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Ewka ucieka z transportu. Znajduje kryjówkę u Nawrota, dawnego kumpla złodzieja, który mieszka w Otwocku. Wraz z nim mieszka Rozi, schroniła się tu po egzekucji kochanka gestapowca. Marysia, szukając pracy, spotyka dawnego nauczyciela.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: Siostra Wiktora, Jadźka, przynosi z więzienia wiadomość, że Łukasz i Wiktor sądzą, iż siedzą przez Andrzeja. Niesłuszne oskarżenie załamuje go. Pomaga mu zakochana Ewa. Dr Kazanowicz, nie mogąc patrzeć na męki psa, strzela do niego.

programme.title: Raz na milion lat - piosenki zespołu Republika
Moda na język polski
programme.desc: Literacko - językowe podróże po Polsce. Autorzy programu sprawdzają jak mówią mieszkańcy naszego kraju, przedstawiciele różnych grup społecznych i zawodowych. Odkrywają na nowo twórczość dobrze nam znanych pisarzy.

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie
programme.desc: Podróż przez polskie miasta i miasteczka - niegdyś tętniące życiem ośrodki społeczności żydowskiej - inspirowana książką Mordechaja Canina "Wśród ruin i popiołów". To wyprawa śladami pamięci, zapomnianej historii i dziedzictwa.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Zwykła uliczna stłuczka staje się zalążkiem skomplikowanej zagadki kryminalnej: w jednym z uczestniczących w niej pojazdów zostaje znalezione ciało zamordowanego kominiarza, Romana Zielińskiego. Prowadzący auto mężczyzna ucieka.

programme.title: Dobre strony
programme.desc: Cykl programów zrealizowany przez Narodowe Centrum Kultury, dotyczący promocji czytelnictwa. O wartościach płynących z czytania opowiadają znane postaci świata kultury. Gośćmi odcinka są: Mery Spolsky i Andrzej Chyra.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Aldona i Borys próbują ustalić kwotę zadośćuczynienia dla pana Bogumiła. Gdy mężczyzna staje się coraz bardziej natarczywy i inicjuje głośną awanturę w ich sklepie, małżeństwo Grzelaków ponownie szuka wsparcia u Natalii.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Zwykła uliczna stłuczka staje się zalążkiem skomplikowanej zagadki kryminalnej: w jednym z uczestniczących w niej pojazdów zostaje znalezione ciało zamordowanego kominiarza, Romana Zielińskiego. Prowadzący auto mężczyzna ucieka.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Wójt nie dowierza technice manipulacji. Czerepach postanawia mu udowodnić jej skuteczność. Zakłada się z wójtem, że uwiedzie księgową, panią Lodzię. Ksiądz nakłania Lucy, żeby kandydowała przeciwko wójtowi, który tumani wyborców.

programme.title: Młodzież kontra, czyli pod ostrzałem
programme.desc: Widowisko publicystyczne z udziałem młodzieży partyjnej, która zadaje pytania zaproszonemu gościowi tj. znaczącemu politykowi lub ważnej osobie życia publicznego. Moderatorem i gospodarzem programu jest osoba prowadząca. Gość: Waldemar Żurek - minister sprawiedliwości, prokurator generalny.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Projekt etiud filmowych przybliżających widzom sylwetki wybitnych polskich naukowców żyjących w różnych zakątkach świata, którzy swoją pracą i odkryciami dali podstawy do rozwoju nauki. W krótkich filmach poznamy niezwykłe historie wybitnych Polaków, którzy pomimo odległości, jaka ich dzieliła od Ojczyzny, sercem byli oddani Polsce, ale swoim umysłem i talentem służyli innym narodom.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester próbuje podjąć decyzję o awansie, ale sąsiedzi znów się kłócą, a i w domu hałas nie ustaje. Patrycja wzywa policję, co prowadzi do niespodziewanego spotkania z dzielnicową, która chyba jako jedyna na świecie śmieje się z żartów Sylwestra.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Zaangażowanie Mariusza w pomoc Jance skutkuje zaniedbywaniem domowych obowiązków, co budzi rosnącą irytację Kasi. Dodatkowo mierzy się ona z problemami wychowawczymi, gdyż Ksawery stanowczo odmawia udziału w konsultacji psychiatrycznej.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Lato 1938 roku. Winni i przyjaciele rodziny bawią się na weselu Andzi i Guido. Jerzyk jest zazdrosny o uczucia mamy. Dopiero rozmowa ze Stanisławem nieco go uspokaja. Kazia i Damian dostają pracę u Iwaszkiewiczów.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W Sandomierzu trwają przygotowania do konkursu tańca. Mieszkańcy uczestniczą w treningach. Córka Fideckich, Magda, która w nim startuje, ma romans z nauczycielem tańca. W nocy płonie jego przyczepa kempingowa, w której znaleziono zwłoki.

programme.title: Paderewski. Człowiek czynu, sukcesu i sławy
programme.desc: Dokument przybliżający sylwetkę Ignacego Paderewskiego - wielkiego polskiego patrioty, światowej sławy pianisty i kompozytora, męża stanu, dyplomaty, polityka i filantropa, dzięki któremu Polska odzyskała niepodległość po I wojnie światowej. Dokonania Paderewskiego przedstawiają amerykańscy prezydenci - Ronald Reagan, John Fitzgerald Kennedy i George Bush senior, oraz prezydent Lech Wałęsa, genera

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester dostaje propozycję awansu, ale nie wie, czy nadaje się na lidera. Miras odkrywa, że internetowe algorytmy traktują go jak kobietę i postanawia "naprawić" swój wizerunek. Bruno uczy się z kolei gry w bejsbol, nieświadomie wkuwając zasady krykieta i palanta.

programme.title: Not Far From Home:5
programme.desc: 這集《阿峇卡巴東南亞電台》的來賓，是紀錄片《家園不遠》的導演陳文良。《家園不遠》是一部探討在台印尼新住民的故事，他們是餐廳經營者、舞者、移工、捏麵人藝術家和一對印尼夫妻。而透過紀錄片呈現，觀眾會看到新移民是如何在台灣這片土地打造自己的家園。

programme.title: Shipwrecks Taiwan:2
programme.desc: 全片探訪了八個台灣的沈船地點，它們曾經是縱橫海上的鋼鐵巨人，因為不同原因而長眠海底，現在成為了眾多海洋生物最溫暖的家。本節目由具備將近30年節目製作與豐富水下攝影經驗的李景白擔任導演，他所帶領的製作團隊包括配樂、剪輯也都是金獎等級的成員，並由藝人王陽明擔任旁白以及潛水引路者。

programme.title: Viva La Vita:2
programme.desc: 《我在工場拍拍手》節目，走訪全台16個工「場」，包括：飛機維修廠、遊艇製造廠、酪農場、螺絲廠、麵包廠、伐木場、米酒廠、玻璃工廠、家具工廠等等，彰顯產品製造的細節美學，以及職人們追求精進的態度，將生硬的產業題材提煉出溫柔的故事。

programme.title: Botanical Wonders:9
programme.desc: 邀請「亞洲廚神」王凱傑(Jason Wang)攜手加拿大籍植物生態學家崔佛(Trevor Padgett)組成探險雙人組，深入高山森林、百年白榕園，揭開臺灣植物的奇幻旅程。

programme.desc: Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents' basement, and with baby number two on the way they're desperate to find a home of their own. It's a race against time, and the Property Brothers step in with a plan.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Super-planner Carson has been crashing at her best friend Leah's place. But it's time she found a Nashville pad of her own. Carson knows exactly what she wants, but finding a picture-perfect property that meets her high standards could prove tricky.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled châteaubriand with charred Broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don't forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf 'n' turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread, then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po'boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale makes a giant seafood feast; lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks... The Porterhouse.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you've ever eaten.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: It's Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much-needed upgrade.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Shqipëria tjetër
programme.desc: Eshtë një cikël reportazhesh në Top Channel, që zbulon anën e panjohur të vendit përmes historive njerëzore, vendeve të veçanta dhe realiteteve të ndryshme nga çdo cep i Shqipërisë. Përmes udhëtimeve në terren, rrëfimeve të banorëve dhe pasqyrimit të traditave, problemeve dhe përpjekjeve të komuniteteve, reportazhet sjellin në ekran një Shqipëri autentike, shpesh të padukshme, me historitë dhe problemet e njerëzve të saj.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Top story

Përmes intervistave ekskluzive, debateve me të ftuar, analizave dhe raportimeve të thelluara, programi ofron një pasqyrë të plotë të zhvillimeve që ndikojnë në jetën publike.

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: Young Dorothy (Dorothy Dwan), a farm girl from Kansas, discovers that she's actually Princess Dorothea, the royal heir to a faraway kingdom called Oz. Suddenly, a powerful tornado whisks Dorothy, her uncle Henry (Frank Alexander) and three farmhands to the magical kingdom. There Dorothy is hailed as the queen of the land by all except authoritarian Prime Minister Kruel (Joseph Swickard), who casts a curse on Dorothy in an attempt maintain his dictatorial reign.

programme.title: Stolen Kisses
programme.desc: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's (Claude Jade) father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses. Stumbling into a position assisting a private detective, Antoine falls for his employers' seductive wife, Fabienne (Delphine Seyrig), and finds that he must choose between the older woman and Christine.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Soft Skin
programme.desc: While flying to Lisbon, Portugal, to give a lecture, a writer and magazine editor, Pierre Lachenay (Jean Desailly), encounters an attractive flight attendant, Nicole (Françoise Dorléac), and winds up spending the night with her. What was intended to be a one-night stand becomes a tumultuous extramarital affair once he gets back to Paris and his wife (Nelly Benedetti) and kids. Pierre tries to keep the affair secret, but, when his wife suspects him, she snaps.

programme.title: Happiness Ahead
programme.desc: A bored heiress (Josephine Hutchinson) leaves high society and falls in love with a window washer (Dick Powell).

programme.title: Here Comes Happiness
programme.desc: A rich girl (Mildred Coles) loves a sandblaster (Edward Norris) instead of the socialite (Richard Ainley) her mother wants her to marry.

programme.title: Princess O'Rourke
programme.desc: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters.

programme.title: Wise Girl
programme.desc: A socialite (Miriam Hopkins) goes Bohemian to save her sister's children from their starving-artist father (Ray Milland) in Greenwich Village.

programme.title: Traveling Saleslady
programme.desc: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson.

programme.title: There Goes My Heart
programme.desc: Eager to break free of her constrained life, heiress Joan Butterfield (Virginia Bruce) runs away from her grandfather's yacht just as reporter Bill Spencer (Fredric March) arrives to get a rare photo of her. Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story.

programme.title: Repent at Leisure
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter.

programme.title: Love and Learn
programme.desc: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton).

programme.title: The Richest Girl in the World
programme.desc: Dorothy Hunter (Miriam Hopkins), the richest girl in the world, has never shown her face to the public. When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has.

programme.title: Sun Valley Serenade
programme.desc: As a surefire way to receive good press, bandleader Phil Corey (Glenn Miller) and his ensemble decide to adopt a war refugee. When it turns out that their adoptee isn't a child, but a pretty Scandinavian woman named Karen Benson (Sonja Henie), it leads to a flirtatious relationship with the group's pianist, Ted Scott (John Payne), who is already involved with singer Vivian Dawn (Lynn Bari). As the band heads to snowy Idaho for a gig, romantic drama, skiing, ice skating and musical numbers ensue.

programme.title: Orchestra Wives
programme.desc: When a touring swing band arrives in her small town, Connie Ward (Ann Rutherford) falls hard for trumpeter Bill Abbot (George Montgomery) and decides to marry him on a whim -- since the band is leaving as quickly as it arrived. Quite unprepared for her new lifestyle, Connie struggles to adjust to the constant travel from one town to another, and also to the pettiness of the other musicians' wives. Eventually, the marriage and the band break up, but Bill is determined to make it all right again.

programme.title: Birth of the Blues
programme.desc: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Girl Crazy
programme.desc: Distracted by female students and performing poorly in the classroom, Danny Churchill Jr. (Mickey Rooney) moves west to a university that his father believes is free of temptation. Soon, though, Danny strikes up a friendship with Ginger Gray (Judy Garland). When Ginger, whose family runs the all-male college, explains that the school has money troubles, creative Danny puts together a big fundraiser. The event highlights their song-and-dance skills and also cements their bond.

programme.title: Strike Up the Band
programme.desc: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater.

programme.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
programme.desc: Col. Robert L. Scott is an adept fighter pilot who unfortunately finds himself too old to fly fighter planes in World War II. Assigned to India, he later meets Maj. Gen. Claire L. Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers.

programme.title: My Wild Irish Rose
programme.desc: In this musical, Chauncey Olcott (Dennis Morgan) -- a character based on the real-life 19th-century singer-songwriter -- starts off as a minstrel show performer, but his life and career completely change when singer Lillian Russell (Andrea King) gives him a starring role in a Broadway show. Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track.

programme.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
programme.desc: While waiting for his Balkan country to vote on whether to abolish its monarchy, Prince Henry (Dennis Morgan) comes to New York City to observe ordinary life. Slipping away in disguise from his welcome party, the prince becomes friends with cab driver Buzz Williams (Jack Carson). After Buzz discovers the prince's identity, he lets his girlfriend, Connie (Joan Leslie), show the royal around the city. As the public wonders where the prince has disappeared to, he and Connie fall in love.

programme.title: The Desert Song
programme.desc: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Ten Tall Men
programme.desc: Sgt. Mike Kincaid is a rough-and-tumble French Foreign Legion leader who, while imprisoned in a stockade, overhears rumors of an enemy attack on his company's fort. Later, in between fighting amongst themselves over a beautiful French lady, Mike and his ragtag group of fighters improvise a plan to kidnap Mahla (Jody Lawrence), the daughter of a local sheik. Though she hates Mike and his band of thieves at first, she soon realizes they are the least of her worries.

programme.title: Sweet Smell of Success
programme.desc: New York City newspaper writer J.J. Hunsecker (Burt Lancaster) holds considerable sway over public opinion with his Broadway column, but one thing that he can't control is his younger sister, Susan (Susan Harrison), who is in a relationship with aspiring jazz guitarist Steve Dallas (Marty Milner). Hunsecker strongly disproves of the romance and recruits publicist Sidney Falco (Tony Curtis) to find a way to split the couple, no matter how ruthless the method.

programme.title: From Here to Eternity
programme.desc: At an Army barracks in Hawaii in the days preceding the attack on Pearl Harbor, lone-wolf soldier and boxing champion Prew Prewitt (Montgomery Clift) refuses to box, preferring to play the bugle instead. Hard-hearted Capt. Holmes (Philip Ober) subjects Prew to a grueling series of punishments while, unknown to Holmes, the gruff but fair Sgt. Warden (Burt Lancaster) engages in a clandestine affair with the captain's mistreated wife (Deborah Kerr).

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Lawman Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and gunfighter John "Doc" Holliday (Kirk Douglas) find themselves together again in Tombstone, Ariz., despite the tumultuous history between them. Earp comes to Arizona on a mission to bring the Clayton clan to justice. Meanwhile, Holliday becomes incensed with the decision of Kate Fisher (Jo Van Fleet) to turn him down in favor of another gunfighter (John Ireland), ultimately leading Holliday to join Earp's side in a confrontation with the Claytons.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Come Back, Little Sheba
programme.desc: Two decades after their hasty wedding, Doc (Burt Lancaster) and Lola (Shirley Booth) are stuck in a deadening and loveless marriage. Doc, who dropped out of medical school when Lola got pregnant, blames Lola for the loss of his life's dream. Lola, who never recovered emotionally from the miscarriage she suffered shortly after their wedding, still mourns the loss of her beloved dog, Sheba. When a beautiful young lodger (Terry Moore) enters their home, long-repressed emotions explode.

programme.title: Die Beet-Brüder
programme.desc: Die „Beet-Brüder“ sind Claus Scholz, Ralf Dammasch und Henrik Drüen. Sie sind zwar nicht blutsverwandt, dafür aber durch ihre Leidenschaft fürs Gärtnern Brüder im Geiste. Die drei hatten schon bei „Ab ins Beet!“ (2005) kräftig mit angepackt und haben nun seit 2014 ihre eigene Show.\n\nWährend Claus die Projekte aussucht, kümmern sich Koordinator Ralf und Maschinist Henrik um die Umsetzung vor Ort.

programme.title: Herrmann und Zacherl liefern ab!
programme.desc: Im Dortmunder „Imbiss-Tempel“ buhlen Alexander Herrmann und Ralf Zacherl um die Gunst der Besteller. Gleich der erste Hinweis sorgt für Verwirrung: Ein Foto zeigt eine Glocke, ein weiterer Hinweis spricht von „Heimatliebe“. Sind Käsespätzle die richtige Antwort?

programme.title: Hot oder Schrott – Die Allestester
programme.desc: Erfindungen, die die Welt nicht braucht, werden bei "Hot oder Schrott" auf den Prüfstand gestellt. Die Allestester unterziehen nützliche und skurrile Artikel dem Praxistest. Ob Studenten, Familien oder Senioren – sie testen die Produkte aus aller Welt auf ihre Alltagstauglichkeit (meist niedrig) und ihren Fun-Faktor (meist hoch).

Големият бариерен риф S1 E1 Големият бариерен риф, поредица от коралови рифове по брега на Куинсланд, е най-голямата структура, създадена от организми. Той се мени с приливите и отливите, сезоните и оформящи сили като ерозията.

В очакване на изригването S1 E2 Европа е разположена върху активни тектонични зони от Исландия до Италия. Древните вулкани под градовете и бреговете ѝ все още представляват рискове за Европа и земите около нея.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E6 Студент описва урагана Мария от 2017 г., който опустошава Пуерто Рико. Градушка унищожава дом на семейство в Далас. Турист в дивата природа се опитва да спаси живота си при внезапно наводнение.

Тексаски спасители на алигатори S1 E5 Арли конструира гениално ново изобретение, което да помага за залавянето на алигатори, но резултатите са смесени. Шанън примамва боязлив алигатор, а Арли и Джесика имат проблеми извън парка.

Дивите бойни полета S2 E2 Изследваме най-суровите алпийски арени на Земята. Рисове ловуват из заснежени гори, червени лисици проследяват мишки под леда, а снежни леопарди рискуват фатално падане при преследвания в Хималаите.

Речни Чудовища S7 E3 Джереми търси животно в Аляска, което може да надвие нищо неподозиращ рибар. Има ли същество в реката, което да отговаря на условията, или вината е на големите акули, оцеляващи в ледени води?
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E17 Непредсказуемото лятно време представлява предизвикателство за жителите на Аляска, които се стремят да събират припаси, за да оцелеят през следващата зима.

Нова Зеландия: Митичните острови на Земята S1 E2 От свръхинтелигентни папагали до зловещи охлюви и магически съзвездия от светещи червеи, това е историята на най-дивите места в Нова Зеландия и най-издръжливите пионери.

Спящи гиганти: неспокойните вулкани на Европа Европа е дом на 100 активни вулкана. Вулканичните изригвания могат да се окажат пагубни за континента. Може ли Европа отново да стане жертва на голямо и опустошително вулканично изригване?
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E17 Непредсказуемото лятно време представлява предизвикателство за жителите на Аляска, които се стремят да събират припаси, за да оцелеят през следващата зима.
Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E5 Капската провинция в Южна Африка е поразена от силна буря и катастрофални горски пожари, които претоварват службите за спешна помощ.

Живот при температури под нулата S4 E18 Жителите на Аляска използват дългите дни за подготовка за предстоящите дълги замръзвания. В Кивалик семейство Хейлстоун започват сезонното прибиране на реколта и събират яйца на чайки край реката.

programme.title: 運動員背後 第13集
programme.desc: 足球、籃球經理人可能聽得比較多，美式足球隊經理人你又聽過了沒有？今集為大家介紹一項在香港比較罕有的運動項目－美式足球，而身為球隊背後支柱的經理人Jason，這個角色可以說是舉足輕重，而Jason 更會分享身為一個幕僚的心路歷程。

programme.title: 創文館 第12集
programme.desc: Timothy 熱衷於教學，分別於澳門演藝學院、香港大學及香港浸會大學都曾任教，同時學生 Trevor 亦會同我們分享他的音樂成果。

programme.title: 環保發現號 第81集
programme.desc: 環保好難搞？你實在太悲觀啦！我們看到的處處都是環保新機遇！《環保發現號》將會帶大家走一趟環保之旅，接觸不同的環保人士，從個人出發，由理念開始，在他們身上取經，如何透過行動實踐環保！既然香港有接近700萬人口，節目就探索出700萬種環保生活！令你重新發現「環保」兩個字，其實唔難！

programme.title: 聲畫合拍 9 第14集
programme.desc: 《螢光蜓影》講述自幽暗江湖中長大的少女小螢，被昆蟲化形之族收留，自幼苦習繩鏢，卻被推向命定的「化蛹」試煉⋯⋯今集請來導演、製片和歌手上來分享拍攝故事。

programme.title: 夜漫遊 第9集
programme.desc: 今集，Yoshi同Anton將會遇上三位特別嘉賓——先有旅居韓國近10年嘅香港人Amanda，帶兩位乘坐夜間快車欣賞首爾靚景，再去本地人最愛嘅海鮮市場食大餐；隨後再有Viu原創劇《完美的家族》嘅導演行定勳、演員金永大，從中八卦佢哋喺韓國拍戲時嘅夜生活。而Yoshi同Anton兩位戲精隨後仲忍唔住喺寺廟上演「狗血劇情」？

programme.title: 雙線運動人生 第65集
programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地。

programme.title: 設計新態度 第71集
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去。

programme.title: 平行教室 第19集
programme.desc: 冰廳主理人-阿峰，承傳港式冰廳文化同時注入新意。他與團隊用心打理店舖日常，在保留經典風味與懷舊氛圍的基礎上，尋求傳統與現代之間的平衡，延續社區的飲食記憶。

programme.title: 設計新態度 第71集
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去。

programme.desc: Depuis 70 ans, Claude Vanony nous fait rire avec son personnage haut en couleur et son regard malicieux sur le monde. programme.title: Snapped – Wenn Frauen töten
programme.desc: 30. August 2011: In Ore City, Texas, geht gegen elf Uhr vormittags ein Notruf ein. Sharon Maxwell meldet einen Fahrzeugbrand, und dass sie ihren Mann Gordon nicht finden kann. Als die Feuerwehr eintrifft, findet sie unter den verkohlten Autoteilen eine Leiche. Die Brandermittler haben Schwierigkeiten, den Toten zu identifizieren, doch sie gehen davon aus, dass es sich tatsächlich um Gordon handelt

programme.title: Snapped – Wenn Frauen töten
programme.desc: Marengo, Iowa, am 19. Juli 2009 um 1:50 Uhr nachts: Die meisten Einwohner schlafen, als es schlagartig mit der Ruhe auf der Mainstreet vorbei ist. Denise Frei wählt den Notruf, weil ihr Mann angegriffen wurde. Als die Polizisten am Tatort eintreffen, finden sie den toten Curtis Bailey blutüberströmt im Wohnzimmer. Seine Verletzungen deuteten auf stumpfe Gewalteinwirkung hin. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Ein Obdachloser hat „Unglück im Glück“: Er versetzt eine wertvolle Uhr, geht ins Kasino und gewinnt 350 000 Dollar. Kurz darauf wird er ermordet. Forensikerin Morgan Brody (Elisabeth Harnois) sichtet die Spuren und bald ist klar, dass der Mann nicht das erste Opfer eines gierigen Killers war….

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Ermittler Greg im Zwielicht: Hat er vor Jahren Beweise gefälscht und so einen Unschuldigen ins Gefängnis gebracht? Julie Finlay (Elisabeth Shue) überprüft mit Feuereifer den alten Fall und scheint zum Missmut der übrigen „CSI“-Kollegen mehr daran interessiert, Gregs Schuld zu beweisen als dessen Unschuld.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Forensiker Eric Delko (Adam Rodriguez) gerät in einen Gewissenskonflikt: Während seine Exkollegen gegen einen mordverdächtigen Obdachlosen ermitteln, soll er für die Anwältin des Angeklagten entlastendes Material aufspüren.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Das Popsternchen Phoeniks verbrennt auf offener Bühne. Die skurrile Todesursache: Ein Elektroschocker, hatte ihre Bräunungscreme in Brand gesetzt… \n\nCalleigh (Emily Procter) blickt mit ihrem Team hinter die Kulissen des glamourösen Musikbiz und erlebt sogleich die erste Überraschung: Das Opfer war ein Double.

programme.title: Leverage 2.0
programme.desc: Auf das Team wartet bereits der nächste Einsatz: Sie nehmen sich einen gierigen Riverboat-Casino-Besitzer vor, bevor dieser für seine geplante Expansion die Häuser langjähriger Anwohner aus New Orleans dem Erdboden gleichmacht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Leverage 2.0
programme.desc: Als Anwalt hatte Harry Wilson (Noah Wyle) dafür gesorgt, dass Gebäudeentwickler Jason Crawley ungeschoren davonkam, obwohl er bei einem seiner Projekte bewusst den Tod von Bauarbeitern in Kauf genommen hatte. Dieses Unrecht will Wilson begleichen.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: Promi-Juwelier Ten Mohs bricht in einem Club tot zusammen. Pathologin Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander) entdeckt das Gift eines Kugelfischs aus dem Amazonas. Entscheidende Hinweise liefert ihr ungeliebter Adoptivvater (David Ogden Stiers), der viele Jahre im Amazonasgebiet geforscht hat.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: Ein Student wurde ermordet. Es stellt sich heraus, dass er für eine App 32 Frauen als fiktiver Partner mit Liebesnachrichten versorgte. Ist unter ihnen die Mörderin? Gerichtsmedizinerin Maura (Sasha Alexander) weigert sich weiterhin, ihren Vater zu treffen. Jane nimmt sie ins Gebet.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: „Ein Hundeleben“ muss kein übles sein. Der preisgekrönte Rottweiler Duke wurde von seinem Frauchen abgöttisch geliebt. Doch nun liegt die Dame tot im Pool, mit Bissspuren. \n\nDa jedoch auch Gift in ihrem Blut gefunden wird, begeben sich Rizzoli (Angie Harmon) und Isles (Sasha Alexander) mitsamt dem Tier auf eine Hundeausstellung, um potenzielle Täter auf sich aufmerksam zu machen.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: 心計第6季:4
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 泰坦第1季:6
programme.desc: 《泰坦》故事講述自黑暗崛起的「羅賓」迪克葛雷森成為一支少年團隊的領導者，招募一群即將成為超級英雄的少年，包括「星火」（Starfire）、「烏鴉/酷姬」（Raven）、「戰鷹」（Hawk）與「白鴿」（Dove）等知名 DC 超級英雄將加入這支無畏的團隊。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:10
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: 心計第6季:5
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 泰坦第1季:7
programme.desc: 《泰坦》故事講述自黑暗崛起的「羅賓」迪克葛雷森成為一支少年團隊的領導者，招募一群即將成為超級英雄的少年，包括「星火」（Starfire）、「烏鴉/酷姬」（Raven）、「戰鷹」（Hawk）與「白鴿」（Dove）等知名 DC 超級英雄將加入這支無畏的團隊。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:11
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

Des civils ukrainiens continuent d'y vivre, tant bien que mal : des enfants jouant dans les hautes herbes, des vieilles dames cuisinant dans une cave encombrée de lit

programme.title: MacGyver

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit
programme.desc: In Dick-Wolf-Krimis sind die Storys nicht selten von realen Fällen inspiriert. Doch hier scheint es eher ein Zufall zu sein: Nur einen Monat nach dem Mord am Journalisten Jamal Khashoggi erzählte die Folge in den USA von einem russischen Chemiker, der bei der Visa-Verlängerung aus seiner Botschaft entführt wird.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Just als Zirkusdirektor Serge mit Pferdetrainerin Ariana speist, schwebt ein maskierter Ninja vom Dach und erschießt ihn! Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub) verdächtigt Serges Ex-Frau Nastasia, eine berühmte Artistin und Scharfschützin. Doch die hat ihren Fuß in Gips: Gibt es ein besseres Alibi? Erst als vor Monks Augen auch noch der Elefantentrainer stirbt, geht dem schrulligen Ermittler ein Licht auf.

programme.title: Monk

programme.title: MacGyver

Was steckt dahinter?

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit

Wurde er wirklich enttarnt und von seinen einstigen Kartellgenossen zur Strecke gebracht? Der Fall scheint auf den ersten Blick klar, aber die Agents Zidan (Zeeko Zaki) und Bell verfolgen noch weitere Spuren...

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Der verurteilte Mörder Jared Renfrew (Todd Stashwick) bittet Mentalist Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), seine Unschuld zu beweisen. Als Gegenleistung will Renfrew sein Wissen über Red John, jenen Serienkiller, der Janes Familie getötet hat, preisgeben. Zunächst skeptisch, lässt sich Jane auf den Deal ein.

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: „Böser Zauber“ im Städtchen Boonville? Der 16-jährige Highschool-Footballstar Cody wurde Opfer eines Ritualmords. Zuvor hatte er Streit mit Tamzin Dove (Azura Skye), die sich als Hexe bezeichnet. Mentalist Patrick (Simon Baker) hat aber auch den Trainer im Visier.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: „Mr. Monk geht mit Sharona ins Theater“, weil deren Schwester, Schauspielerin Gail, eine Hauptrolle innehat. Während des Auftritts sticht diese ihren Schauspielkollegen auf der Bühne nieder – und er steht nicht mehr auf. Nun wird sie des Mordes bezichtigt, und Mr. Monk muss klären, was es mit dem Fall wirklich auf sich hat...

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty and Terry unearth a rare 1969 Impala with 14,000 original miles on it; the guys go to work on getting it running and putting it on bags with new wheels and tires; Pete is looking to upgrade his 1958 Impala.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty and Pete need to find a Volkswagen delivery bus to round out a collector's dream of creating a VW museum; they track down an extremely rare panel van that's been out to pasture under a pecan tree, but Shorty and Pete think it will be perfect.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Work continues on the Volkswagen delivery bus as Shorty gets down in the paint booth on the beast; it's time to get this bus across the finish line with a new motor, new suspension, new stance and new wheels and tires.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: After multiple unsuccessful attempts at other shops, Sanders turns to Shorty's garage as a last resort for his 1956 Chevrolet Bel Air restoration; Joel and Shorty work to finally make the family's dream car road-ready.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Paul decides to take one of his prized 1959s and go full lowrider with hydraulics and a full custom lowrider paint job; Shorty's wife Lupe has a 1992 Mustang GT 5.0, and Shorty has a honey do list to get this car back to its original glory.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty's buddy Tommy has a '69 Camaro that needs some love, with damaged paint on the hood and malfunctioning headlight motors; another friend, T-bone, stops by with his '65 Impala for an air ride, updated interior and repainted steering wheel.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Arturo is a good friend of the shop, and his classic Nova will be a monster, with a rebuilt supercharged 6.2 LS, plus upgrades to the chassis and brakes; the crew revives a classic 1924 LaFrance fire truck for the nearby Cedar Hill Fire Department.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: An Amber Glow 1955 DeSoto might be pink, but it has a hemi under the hood; 2000 Chevy dually is a monster, but needs a new paint job, interior and air ride system.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty tries to match the Ember Glow hemi's original color, then works his magic in the paint booth; Joel tries to figure out how to install an aftermarket AC; PG works on the interior; the crew is left with an enormous amount of trim.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: A big fan of the movie "Training Day" wants his '78 Monte Carlo to be built in the same vein; the G-body needs the works, including a swapped LS, beefed-up brakes and suspension and a new interior; Shorty's G10 parts runner van needs a facelift.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: After losing a grandson in a racetrack crash, Rick Wilson and his family want to raise money to promote safety at tracks around Texas; they enlist Shorty and the team to build a 1956 Corvette that will be auctioned off for their cause.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: The '56 Corvette is complete, but not without a couple of twists; the family decides to change the body color from red to arctic blue with a silver teardrop; Shorty brings in the best in the business for a lowrider paint seminar at the shop.

programme.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programme.desc: Shorty's is traditionally a Chevy shop, but this week, a Ford collector who's always dreamed of a Shorty paint job convinces them to take on his '71 Torino GT; but what looks like a pretty straight car is hiding a can of worms underneath.

programme.desc: The guys transform a stripped-out Mini into a fully fledged spec car.

programme.desc: The guys investigate an intriguing listing about a $3,250 Jeep Comanche.

programme.desc: The guys resuscitate a Subaru Legacy while adding some overlanding goodies.

programme.desc: The guys pick up an LS-swapped Silverado with some transmission issues.

programme.title: Runs Good
programme.desc: Dan, Shea and Aaron take on a stalled Nissan Skyline GTS-t drift project.

programme.title: Runs Good
programme.desc: What was supposed to be an unfinished project feels more like a mechanic special; with problem after problem, it looks like this car was closer to ending up in a landfill than laying down 11s leaving the car meet.

programme.desc: A shop owner's crew builds a SR20-powered Ford Ranger Urban Assault Vehicle, but when the turbo gives out, he knows it needed to go before it become more of a distraction; Aaron fixes the reliability issues; Dan and Shea go in on suspension.

programme.title: Runs Good
